items.text: After his release, Dipke posted a picture of Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka on X, writing that he is now waiting for the release of 'these two brothers' of his. Both are still in judicial custody.
Cockroach Janta Party leader Abhijeet Dipke was released on conditional bail after signing a peace bond.
Ravish Kumar: where did the bogus 'regime change' theory come from, a new excuse to push the SIR issue aside?
Left organisations kept up their protest on Raisina Road. Heavy police and paramilitary forces were deployed to stop the RWP(I) and KYS protesters.
AIMSS, the Krantikari Yuva Sangathan and other left organisations marched to Delhi Police headquarters against the police action.

Abhijeet Dipke was to be produced before the Special Executive Magistrate (SEM) at Mandir Marg police station around noon. CJP's legal head Ratna Singh gave the information; security outside the station was stepped up.

Delhi Police filed two or more FIRs over Friday's protests in Connaught Place and Mandi House for violating prohibitory orders under Section 163. Police are scanning CCTV footage and warned of strict action against repeat offenders.

items.h: Delhi Police arrested CJP's Abhijeet Dipke; he was to appear in court today

items.text: Cockroach Janta Party said on X that Dipke had not been released yet and that his continued detention was wrong; it demanded his immediate release.

items.h: Action against Dipke under Sections 126 and 170 of the BNSS; the protesters' four demands stand

items.text: According to police sources, Dipke had received two notices barring him from Central Park. In court, police may argue that he violated his earlier peace bond (Rs 50,000, one year of good conduct).

After her release, AISA president Neha Bora said she was kept at R.K. Puram police station overnight and her lawyers took five to six hours to meet her. She repeated the demand for Gyanesh Kumar's impeachment and for stopping the SIR.
The other side: National Restaurant Association of India treasurer Manpreet Singh said repeated protests hurt Connaught Place businesses, with sales at zero in some places on some days.

items.h: Neha Bora released after action under Section 65 of the Delhi Police Act; Dipke arrested

items.text: According to AISA, Neha Bora was found at R.K. Puram police station around midnight. Her lawyer alleged she was taken to the Anti-Narcotics Task Force office in Palam, denied access to lawyers there and then moved to an unknown place. Police made no statement on this.

Advocate Shailendra Mani Tripathi filed a contempt petition in the Supreme Court over the closure of metro stations and curbs on trains. It alleges the court's 9 October directions were not followed; it names the home secretary, the Delhi police commissioner and the DMRC chief.
